verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a compliance and registered-agent service platform, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes, one blocked by a Cloudflare challenge and one redirecting to that walled host. Neither says anything about API credentials or permission scoping, so there is no evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
